main_text.p: Missiones: Aff. אַחַר שְׁלוּחֶיהָ Post dimissiones ejus, Exod. 18. v.2. id est, Postquam dimisisset vel remisisset eam.

שְׁלֹחָן masc. Mensa, à ciborum Missione vel Missu: שֻׁלְחָן עָרוּךְ Mensa instructa; Ezech.23.41. Aff. מַאֲכַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹ Cibus mensæ ejus, 1.Regum 10.5. Plur. שֻׁלְחָנוֹת Mensæ, Jesa.28.8. Constr. לְשֻׁלְחָנוֹת הַכֶּסֶף Pro mensis argenteis, 1.Par.28.16.
שִׁלּוּחוֹת f.p. Propagines: Aff. שְׁלוּחֹתֶיהָ נִטְּשׁוּ Propagines ejus evelluntur, Jesa.16.8.

מִשְׁלַחַת m. Extensio, Emissio: Constr. בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדְכֶם In omni extensione manus vestræ, Deut.12.7. id est, In omni re ad quam extenderitis manum vestram: לְמִשְׁלַח שׁוֹר Pro emissione bovis, Jesai7.v.25. id est, Loco pascuo in quem bos immittatur.
מִשְׁלַח m. Missus, Missio, Immissio, Jes.11.4. וּמִשְׁלַח מָנוֹת Et missu portionum, Esth.9.19.
מִשְׁלַחַת f. Missio, Psal.78.49. Missile, Eccl.8.8.

שָׁלַט Dominati, Dominium exercere, Dominium habere. Construitur cum Præposit. עַל & ב: Præterit. שָׁלַט הָאָדָם בְּאָדָם Dominatur homo in hominem, Eccles.8.9. שָׁלְטוּ עַל הָעָם Dominabantur in populo, super populum, Neh.5.15. Chald. Præter. דִּי לָא שְׁלַט נוּרָא Quòd non dominatus esset ignis, Dan.3.27. שְׁלַטוּ Dominati sunt, Dan.6.24. Futurum, יִשְׁלַט Daniel.5.v.7. תִּשְׁלַט בְּכָל אַרְעָא Dominatur in tota terra, Dan.3.39. תִּשְׁלַט Dominaberis, Daniel.5.v.16. Hiph. הִשְׁלִיט Dominari fecit; Dominium concessit, Dominari sivit, Copiam vel potestatem fecit. Præterit. וְהִשְׁלִיטוֹ Et dominium, id est, copiam concessit ei, Eccles.5.18. Futur. וְלֹא יַשְׁלִיטֶנּוּ Et non facit copiam ipsi, Eccl.6.2. וְאַל תַּשְׁלֵט בִּי Nesinas dominari in me, Psal.119. v.133.

page.notes: Printed "Psal.119." is cut at the line end and read as "119" from context; "v.133." is set alone at the right. Hebrew vowel points in the dictionary entries are read as far as the scan allows; the Hebrew letters in the running head and the final Hebrew word are the least certain and may contain small errors. "Jesai7.v.25." and "Nesinas" are printed as shown, with the printer's spacing and spelling.
